record.name: Malawi
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A first national AI strategy is drafted and in stakeholder consultation as of August 2026; the source read names no safety or evaluation body.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: MW-search = searches 1, 2 (en, en). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The eGovernment department states that the national AI strategy is drafted and undergoing consultation, describing the ministry-led governance process.

related_bodies.name: Department of e-Government
related_bodies.role: It leads the national AI strategy drafting with UNDP; it is not an evaluation body.

record.notes:
The earlier government project page reports a Principal Secretary's remarks. A possible public-sector AI bill appeared in search results but was not read.

The ministry reports validation of an AI readiness assessment with UNESCO, covering policy, infrastructure and institutional capacity. English-language searches for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models included a separate search of gov.mw.

next_check.reason: Check whether the strategy is adopted and whether it proposes an evaluation or oversight body.
